responsibility: Implements the OpenRISC backend’s target hooks and RTL expansion logic. This file owns per-function machine frame data, option override setup, frame-layout computation, save/restore and prologue/epilogue generation, calling convention helpers, operand/address legitimacy checks, PIC and trampoline support, atomic compare-exchange/exchange/fetch-op expansion, operand printing, profiling and EH support, and thunk assembly emission, then registers those services through targetm hook definitions.
same_name_distinction: Among the or1k files, this is the executable C++ implementation file that realizes backend behavior through target hook functions and RTL expanders. Unlike or1k.h's macro definitions, or1k.md's declarative instruction patterns, and or1k.opt's option metadata, it contains the procedural code for frame layout, prologue/epilogue, calling convention helpers, address legitimacy, atomics, operand printing, and thunk emission.
